description: Aircraft displayed at Klisura in the village of Kralje in the Andrijevica municipality; the OpenStreetMap surveyor transcribed the inscription „Avion izložen u čast četiri pilota ratnog vazduhoplovstva“ — aircraft displayed in honour of four air force pilots; no type; no serial; it stands beside the village heritage museum on the Andrijevica tourist board's cultural route; the only mapped aircraft monument in Montenegro
museum_name: Spomen-avion u čast četiri pilota -- Kralje
